概念.適用: モデルを起こすとき、変更理由が同じものをまとめ、違うものを分ける。層の名前は、その単位に付ける

出典.meta: Robert C. Martin, The Single Responsibility Principle
出典.引用: Gather together the things that change for the same reasons.  Separate those things that change for different reasons.

概念.適用: 外は内を指してよく、内は外を指さない。この向きを、層の場所の規則1件で検査する

出典.meta: Robert C. Martin, The Clean Architecture
出典.引用: Nothing in an inner circle can know anything at all about something in an outer circle.

概念.適用: 採るアーキテクチャが明示されないときの既定。境界の定義は内側が持ち、外側が実装を持つ

出典.引用: Allow an application to equally be driven by users, programs, automated test or batch scripts, and to be developed and tested in isolation from its eventual run-time devices and databases.
